title: Office performance
question: The new metrics show the office at 4,130 draw calls on desktop and 2,714 on phone (phone budget 250; it was 1,305 on phone before the style pass). Every place also has 270-880 ms hitches, probably the next place loading. Fix it now?

options.label: Fix now, keep the look
options.note: Merge static meshes (the batching pass already exists), share materials, instance repeated props (chairs, monitors, binders) and load the next place in slices so it doesn't hitch. Target: phone office near its budget, same look in before/after screenshots.

options.label: Fix now, and allow a lighter look on phone
options.note: As above, plus phone may drop some modelled detail or surface patterns if that's what it takes.

decision: Fix now, lighter look on phone allowed; low priority but should be done
